paragraph: Today's Granville composite lands at a cautious 60 out of 100, heavily capped by an active divergence warning as SPY grinds higher while the RSP/SPY breadth ratio slips 0.39%. Beneath this surface hesitation, internal leadership flashes conflicting macro signals, highlighted by a bullish 3.09% surge in bellwether semis (SOXX/SPY) and a 3.74% jump in risk appetite (SPHB/SPLV), offset by a lagging transport sector (IYT/SPY) down 0.63% and defensive XLP/XLY rotation tightening 1.66%. Meanwhile, cross-asset plumbing reflects an elevated VIX level of 23.81 with front-loaded fear skewing up 1.7 points, though credit remains well-anchored with high-yield spreads stable at 3.77% alongside falling 10-year real yields at 2.73%. Given the persistent cap on breadth despite isolated risk-on leadership and an anxious volatility backdrop, the session's directional lean favors a choppy, defensive-biased consolidation.
